resources.string: Zakhire va/ya dastresi be ettela\'at-e shakhsi baraye ta\'yid-e hoviat-e shoma.

Entekhabhaye shoma be ma komak mikonand ta ettela\'at-e shakhsi-ye shoma ra hefazat konim va fanavari-ye khod ra behbud dahim, dar hali ke balatarin standardhaye harim-e khosusi-ye dadeha ra, haman-tor ke dar %1$s tozih dade shode ast, hefz mikonim.
Man rezayat midaham ke era\'e-konande az dadehaye shakhsi-ye man baraye behine-sazi-ye fanavari-ye khod estefade konad.
Baraye mavared-e zir be rezayat-e shoma niaz darim:
Hala be tanzimat-e dastresi hedayat mishavid; dar anja bayad ejaze-ye dorbin ra be barname bedahid.
Lotfan dar tanzimat-e dastresi-haye barname, ejaze-ye dorbin ra bedahid.
